title: Chapter 6: Five Elements Technique
paragraphs: Chen Mobai checked the time and realized there was still over an hour before the first batch of students in the Cultivation Chambers would finish. Instead of leaving, he decided to use the time to ask more questions about purifying and enhancing Spiritual Roots.

"Yan Bingxuan's family must have some experts who knew that her Spiritual Root could be transformed into an Ice Spiritual Root using the Frost Condensation Method. That's why she's been focusing her cultivation efforts in that direction from the very beginning."
"Purifying and enhancing a Spiritual Root requires less time and resources at lower cultivation stages."

"She's already at Late-Stage Qi Refinement at such a young age. Conservatively, she could attempt Foundation Establishment at least three times. That's why she's aiming to transform her Spiritual Root into an Ice Spiritual Root before reaching Qi Refinement Completion."

"If she succeeds, she could gain automatic admission to the Natural Palace, one of the Ten Great Palaces. With further progress, she might even pass the rigorous entrance examination for the Four Great Dao Academies, ascending to unprecedented heights."

The Four Great Dao Academies were founded by the five Soul Transformation Patriarchs who established the Immortal Sect. Every graduate is destined to become a high-ranking leader within the Immortal Sect. For millennia, the success rate for Foundation Establishment among students of the Four Great Dao Academies has exceeded eighty percent.

In Danxia City, a remote blessed land on the fringes of the Immortal Sect, the last person to gain admission to the Four Great Dao Academies was Crimson-Robed True Person Yu Tianguang, who succeeded in Golden Core Formation a century ago.
After leaving Old Man Ding's office, Chen Mobai waited for over ten minutes and became part of the second group to enter the Cultivation Chamber.

He secured his phone, activated the assisted cultivation recording mode, and settled into a meditative posture. Once again, he began circulating the Qi Nourishment Technique, refining the spiritual power he had gained from the Medicinal Pills and integrating it into his own.
Time flowed slowly. As always, the Soul-Waking Charm roused Chen Mobai from his meditative trance.
He emerged from the Cultivation Chamber to find only the third group of a dozen unlucky stragglers remaining outside.
Looking around, he spotted his deskmate Lu Hongsheng and a few other classmates he got along with. After exchanging brief greetings, they parted ways to head home.

In the past, these close-knit classmates would often gather after school for Spiritual Tea and small games to practice their Spells. But since entering their final year of high school, all such leisure activities had been abandoned.
The intense pressure of college entrance exams had even spurred Lu Hongsheng, his usually lazy deskmate with a mediocre Spiritual Root, to start working diligently.
Before heading home, Chen Mobai stopped at a roadside convenience store to buy a box of glass beads for practicing spiritual power manipulation.
Once home, while waiting for his rice to cook, he cut some small sheets of Talisman Paper and logged onto the online trading platform. He found only one local cultivator had made a bid.
Eighteen Merit Points.
A bit low, but under normal circumstances, Chen Mobai would have agreed to the trade. After all, his small workshop products were always cheaper than those from proper stores.
However, today he wanted to explore the Water Abode accessed through the Turtle Shell's teleportation again, so he wasn't in a hurry to make a deal.
After eating and washing up, Chen Mobai returned to his room.
He picked up the Turtle Shell and examined it closely, but just like the previous night, it remained an ordinary old shell, blackened by smoke and fire, devoid of Spiritual Energy.
If not for yesterday's magical journey, Chen Mobai would never have believed this thing was actually a Spatial Artifact.
Placing the Turtle Shell in the bedside table drawer, Chen Mobai pulled out his phone and tapped the "Turtle Gem" app.
After experimenting with it overnight, he had gained a basic understanding of the app's functions.
The app had three functions:
* Recall: Returning to this location. Whether "this location" referred to his room or the Turtle Shell's original location remained to be verified.
* Teleport: Closely related to Recall, Chen Mobai understood this to be the culprit that had transported him to the mysterious Water Abode yesterday.
Only the finalProxyremained unresolved.

Clearly, the three functions couldn't be used indefinitely. The virtual buttons for these functions would only activate when they lit up on the software interface, allowing a touch to trigger them. Currently, onlyTeleportwas illuminated.
Last night, Chen Mobai stayed up until 3 a.m. to discover this. He immediately usedTeleportagain to return to the Water Abode.
Though he found nothing new, spending the night cultivating in the Second-Tier Spiritual Energy Site had dissipated about 50-60% of the side effects from consuming the Medicinal Pills.

Chen Mobai estimated that another two or three days of secluded cultivation in the Water Abode would eliminate the lingering risks from his breakthrough attempt. After that, he could resume practicing the Five Elements Art and advance his Qi Refinement stage.
It was precisely this prospect that emboldened Chen Mobai to venture back to the Water Abode, even considering attempting to breach the Restriction guarding the Rear Hall.
This was a Second-Tier Mid-Grade Spiritual Land. Within the Immortal Sect, renting such a level of Earth Vein Spiritual Energy cost 160 Merit Points per month.

By this calculation, each day Chen Mobai spent cultivating in the Water Abode was equivalent to freeloading 5.33 Merit Points. How pitiful that his diligent efforts crafting Talisman Paper only earned him a meager 20-30 Merit Points per month.
With this realization, it was no wonder Chen Mobai looked down on his meager online workshop business.

"Based on the time it took for yesterday's two round trips, the cooldown forTeleportshould be 6 hours, whileRecalltakes longer, requiring 10 hours. The cooldown timer starts from the moment the ability is last used..."
Chen Mobai mentally calculated the timestamps from his two experiences last night, arriving at a preliminary conclusion.
Half an hour later, exactly 10 hours had passed since his morning teleport back, and theRecallbutton on his phone glowed brightly, protruding slightly.
This meant that if he encountered any trouble on his next trip, he could immediately return.
Chen Mobai immediately hung a "Seclusion: Do Not Disturb" sign on his door, locked it from the inside, took a deep breath, and tapped the now-prominentTeleportbutton on his Turtle Gem interface.
Select Teleport Location 1 (Unnamed)?
Chen Mobai tapped "Yes."
A silver flash erupted, and his entire body seemed to dissolve into light. After approximately five or six seconds, he vanished from the room.
He looked up.
Facing the familiar underwater environment, Chen Mobai suppressed the joy bubbling within him.
Though he didn't know exactly where he was, at least he had secured a Second-Tier Mid-Grade secret base.

He retrieved the box of glass beads he had prepared earlier and infused them with spiritual energy. The originally transparent beads began to radiate vibrant, multicolored light. This was due to Chen Mobai's practice of the Five Elements Art, which harmonizes the five elemental attributes of spiritual energy.

The Five Elements Art was a foundational technique created by a Soul Transformation Patriarch of the Immortal Sect after millennia of painstaking research. When cultivated by any cultivator, it automatically converts their spiritual energy into the attributes most suitable for their innate qualities. In essence, it's a Qi Refinement method tailored to each cultivator's constitution and Spiritual Root, ensuring optimal compatibility.
For example, Chen Mobai's Spiritual Root attributes were: Metal 23, Wood 27, Water 23, Fire 17, Earth 10.

Therefore, the spiritual energy produced by his cultivation of the Five Elements Art would naturally be 23% metal-attributed, 27% wood-attributed, and so on—perfectly aligning with his Spiritual Root attributes.

Moreover, these five elemental energies circulate in a mutually nourishing cycle, accelerating realm advancement during cultivation. This art forms the cornerstone of the Immortal Sect's ability to sustain universal cultivation on Diyuan Star, a resource-poor planet.
